kind: generic semantic-pipeline invariants, not per-query hard-coded assertions and not browser E2E

checks.detail: shortcuts: What is RAG? | How does MapReduce work? | How do agents use tools?
every evaluation query produces visible text
every citation points to a chunk accepted by the generic semantic filter
all BM25 hits remain in the folded reference panel
no internal prompt/debug identifiers or placeholder directions are rendered
answers contain one to five concise source-grounded statements with citations
no identify/describe filler; every line is a substantive cleaned source extract
formula clauses cannot be extracted from ambiguous multi-formula comparison tables
